shots.title: Home
shots.blurb: What you are playing, and what is waiting for you.

shots.title: Library
shots.blurb: Every game Steam has installed - click one and Steam starts it.

shots.title: Mods
shots.blurb: Any installed game: Thunderstore, GameBanana, Nexus Mods and the Workshop, together.

shots.title: Minecraft
shots.blurb: Whatever launcher you already use.

shots.title: Nyxen in the tray
shots.blurb: Right-click the icon by the clock: the song playing, your status, the call, your games, a screenshot and Quit.

shots.title: Minecraft in 3D blocks
shots.blurb: The live map as real cubes from your save - one switch between 2D and 3D, friends, waypoints, your hotbar and the time of day.

shots.title: Nyxen Space (beta)
shots.blurb: A 3D place for friends in Social: chrome figures you dress up, a mic over whoever talks, blue chat bubbles, DJ decks and screens for shared screens.

shots.title: Quick build
shots.blurb: Drag an area and pick a house, shop, office tower, apartments, park, parking or road - this street took seven drags.

shots.title: The quick build menu
shots.blurb: It opens beside the area you dragged, and whatever you pick is built to fit it, facing you.

shots.title: First person
shots.blurb: See the Space through your own eyes - one button, F5 or the mouse wheel.

shots.title: Dark or white
shots.blurb: One button flips the Space between a night sky and a bright grey one.

shots.title: A campfire night
shots.blurb: Sit round the fire with your friends - it snows for everyone when anyone picks snow.

shots.title: Games in the Space
shots.blurb: Coin rush: a minute to grab the most coins, everyone at once. Tag is one button away too.

shots.title: Social home
shots.blurb: Who is online, what they play and listen to - songs with their covers, straight from Spotify.

shots.title: A natural voice
shots.blurb: One download and the assistant sounds like a person - on your PC, no key.

shots.title: Retro
shots.blurb: RetroArch, your ROMs, and their achievements.

shots.title: Achievements
shots.blurb: Everything you have earned, and your rarest unlocks.

shots.title: Assistant
shots.blurb: Ask about the game in front of you.

shots.title: Guides
shots.blurb: Videos and walkthroughs for the game you loaded.

shots.title: Rooms
shots.blurb: Voice, chat, music anyone can DJ, game nights and modpacks - in one place.

shots.title: Profiles
shots.blurb: What your friends are playing and listening to - Roblox and Minecraft included, Spotify and Apple Music too.

shots.title: Messages
shots.blurb: Replies, reactions, edits, typing and seen - with calls, screen share and music together.

shots.title: Nyxen Eclipse
shots.blurb: Twenty animated rings - or build your own - plus name effects and chat bubbles.

shots.title: Themes
shots.blurb: 62 themes, 22 of them animated. This one is Synthwave.

shots.title: Layouts
shots.blurb: Eleven interface styles that move the navigation itself - sidebar, mirrored sidebar, rail, top bar, floating glass, hub, zen, couch or a dock like this one.
